title: What Sales Teams Build with AI: ROI Calculators, CRMs, and Custom Demo Tools
summary: What sales teams build with AI: ROI calculators, demo environments, lead research dashboards, and custom CRMs. Each tool replaces a SaaS subscription — built in an afternoon.
body_markdown: Go to[blink.new](https://blink.new/) and describe what you need in plain language. For a ROI calculator: "Build an ROI calculator for a \[describe your product\] company. Inputs: current monthly spend on \[problem\], team size, and hours saved per week. Calculate: monthly savings, annual ROI, and months to break even. Add a 'Download PDF' button. Use brand color \[hex\]." Be specific about inputs and outputs — precision here reduces the iteration cycles.
